title: A Window Seat
story: Hugo found his seat on the coach and felt lucky because it was by the window. He put his bag under the seat in front and kept a bottle of water in the pocket beside him. Nia sat down in the aisle seat and said hello. She was going to the same town for a job interview. The coach left the station on time and rolled onto the main road. For a while Hugo watched fields, small houses, and a long line of trees. Then the sky grew dark and rain began to hit the glass. Nia opened a book, but the coach shook and she could not read. Hugo offered to change seats so she could look out and rest her eyes. Nia thanked him and said she was fine in the aisle. Halfway there, the coach stopped at a service area. Hugo bought a sandwich and was careful to keep his ticket in his jacket. Back on the coach, he returned to the window and wiped a small circle on the glass with his sleeve. They talked about interviews, rivers, and how a long ride feels shorter with company. When the town appeared, he smiled at the station clock. He had kept the window seat, made a new friend, and arrived ready for the week.
